item.title: Workshop: Kinetic Equations and Scaling Limits
item.description:
A one-day workshop devoted to kinetic equations and scaling limits.

Program

  • Minicourse (1 h 30): Kléber Carrapatoso (École Polytechnique).
  • Invited talks (about 45 minutes): Antonin Chodron de Courcel (École normale supérieure–PSL), Carmela Moschella (University of Oxford), Chenjiayue Qi (Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques–UPS), and Haoling Xiang (Imperial College London).

Venue

Laboratoire Jacques-Louis Lions (LJLL), Sorbonne Université
4 place Jussieu, 75005 Paris — Room 15-16 309

Organizers

Zhe Chen (Université Paris Cité), Iulia Cristian (Sorbonne Université), Ruiyang Dai (Centre Inria de l’université de Bordeaux), and Lucas Ertzbischoff (Université Paris Dauphine–PSL).

Supported by the BOUM project of the SMAI, with additional support from the CNRS.
